entries.0035a4cb597f1a4b: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,256,896 million, up 4.7% year on year, with revenue increasing in all business segments. Revenue is divided into revenue from contracts with customers of ¥1,158,411 million (of which security contract income was ¥555,133 million) and other income of ¥98,485 million. Revenue from external customers by [[term:segment|segment]] was: Security Services Business ¥660,602 million, Disaster Prevention Business ¥186,884 million, BPO/ICT Business ¥129,901 million, Medical Services Business ¥92,086 million, Insurance Business ¥65,401 million, Geospatial Information Services Business ¥60,645 million, and Other Business ¥61,375 million.

entries.23ea3182dfc6703a: The largest is the Security Services Business, which centers on centralized systems (online security systems) for businesses and homes, provides on-site guarding and cash transport services, and sells safety products. In addition, there is the Disaster Prevention Business, which provides automatic fire alarm and fire extinguishing equipment to office buildings and plants; the Medical Services Business, which provides home medical care such as visiting nursing and operates senior residences; the Insurance Business, centered on non-life insurance; the Geospatial Information Services Business, which provides surveying and measurement using aircraft and artificial satellites; and the BPO/ICT Business, which offers data centers, information security, contact center operations and others. It also runs other businesses, including real estate leasing and building equipment construction.
entries.27ef1c045ee57ccb: The group comprises SECOM CO., LTD. (Shibuya-ku, Tokyo), 148 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 17 equity-method affiliates. It regards itself as a pioneer of the security services business in Japan and has expanded overseas into 18 countries and regions.

The Disaster Prevention Business serves facilities such as office buildings, plants, tunnels, cultural properties, ships and housing, and the Geospatial Information Services Business serves public institutions such as national and local governments, private companies, and foreign government agencies.
